_comment: All damage configs validated via check_fragment_adjacency.py --remove_set. piece_0=bowl/bottom, piece_1/3/6/7/9/10/11=rim, piece_2/5/8=handle, piece_4=neck, piece_8=handle+little rim. handle_simple/handle_severe and rim_simple/rim_severe are each two different single-piece damage spots, not an escalating size (consistent with wine_glass's approach for regions without a clean size progression). Rotation computed via PCA (compute_base_rotation.py) - this vase's raw mesh has its long axis along Y, not Z, unlike beer_bottle/wine_glass.
